description: plugins/ralph-overview/tools/overview-mcp/README.md:174 still says `pnpm --filter @gim-home/ralph-overview-mcp build` even though this same file's diff converted every other `pnpm`/`pnpm --filter` invocation to `npm run build --workspace=tools/overview-mcp` (see lines 12-13, 44-47, 162-164).
